title: AutonomyProfile
description: Immutable published policy and supervision configuration (spec 18.1). Profiles under comparison: hard-controls-only, classifier-assisted, contextual review, full-call review, and session review (spec 15.3).

name.description: Profile family name, for example hard-controls-only or contextual-review.

status.description: Published versions are immutable; changes require a new version (spec 18.1).

supersedes.description: Previous profile version this one replaces.

controls.description: Deterministic hard controls enforced by the broker without an LLM decision (spec 5.3, 11.1).

items.description: A3 is deliberately unrepresentable: irreversible external effects are not authorized in beta (spec 6.1).

destination_policy.description: Beta allows only deny-by-default destination policy (spec 13.1).

max_tree_cost.description: Tree-wide cumulative money limit shared across delegation children (spec 12, F13).

max_tree_tokens.description: Tree-wide cumulative token limit shared across delegation children (spec 12, F13).

supervision.description: Layer configuration for the supervision stack in spec 11.1. The deterministic gate and the nonzero sentinel sample cannot be disabled (spec 11.1, 15.1); the comparison arms from spec 15.3 toggle only the detector and reviewer layers.

applies_to.description: The deterministic gate cannot be disabled for external effects (spec 11.1).

enabled.description: Fast detector over every supported event (spec 11.1).

deadline_ms.description: Decision deadline. Spec 21 proposes a 3-second default.

on_timeout.description: Timeout fallback. A silent allow is not representable (spec 10.2, 21).

scope.description: Risk-routed selection or full-call review; both profiles are required comparisons (spec 15.3).

max_session_events.description: Review budget. Sessions that exceed it are marked incomplete, never clean (spec 11.3).

incremental_windows.description: Bounded incremental review for long sessions (spec 11.3).

enabled.description: The nonzero random sentinel sample cannot be disabled (spec 15.1, AC-017); only its rate is configurable.

uniform_sample_rate.description: Nonzero uniform random sentinel sample over clean traffic (spec 15.1, AC-017).

randomization_key_ref.description: Reference to the randomization keys, kept outside worker access (spec 15.1).

restart_from.description: Alternatives must restart from a checkpoint before the questionable effect (spec 11.5).

preserve_prior_evidence.description: Prior suspicious evidence is never erased when an alternative looks benign (spec 11.5).
